coverage_assessment: Bounded first-pass open-web research in Spanish and English captured 16 exact ordered search invocations and 370 result headers. It produced 32 source cards, all search_only; two exact-URL body attempts ended in Cache miss with no HTTP status or article body, so current-unit body reads are zero. Four provisional event candidates retain unknown turnout, event boundaries, violence and state responses; scheduled, cancelled, foreign-target and work-stoppage-only leads are separately excluded or left as gaps. Search indexing does not establish exhaustiveness or event absence; local archive and LexisNexis coverage are unknown.
